answer: In this fable, every identity must wander an opal labyrinth whose rings grow: the k-th identity stakes the k-th centred hexagonal number of opals (first 1, second 7, third 19, tenth 271), so ten identities stake exactly 1,000 opals. Each ring also takes one hour to wander, so the hundredth fake waits 99 hours and stakes 29,701 opals, nearly thirty times the first ten combined.
